notes.title: Home Defender 1.2.01 Update
notes.content:
- improved stability
- White Flag removed from inventory (new button to restart the game)

notes.title: Home Defender 1.2 Update
notes.content:
Update 1.2
- Fixed gameplay and camera bugs
- New inventory system
- Added new options menu
- 9 minutes Timer added
- Firecrackers are a new throwing weapon
- The player can comment on various situations
- Traps have a 10-second timer
- New task: Save your neighbor

notes.title: Home Defender 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Update 1.1
- The time for the bandits to arrive has been extended by an additional 2 minutes
- A health and stamina bar has been added
- Some enemies have less health, which makes them easier to defeat
- 10 second inventory location reminder
- short information on the screen about the collected item
